Contribution à l'évolution des leads GA: Contribution to the change in valuations
Leads GA dont la session a commencé sur: GA4 leads whose session started on this page
Leads du back-office (extraction BO) hor: Back-office leads (BO extraction) excluding duplicates, tests and non-production leads. A measure distinct from GA4 Leads: the BO also counts requests that GA4 does not see (consent, blockers).
Pages de la propriété Search Console par: Pages of the Search Console property by clicks. Bounce, GA4 Leads and Conv. come from GA4: bounce is measured per page view; leads attach each valuation request to the session's landing page, and Conv. = leads ÷ the page's landing sessions (shown from 100 sessions).
Rebond, Leads GA et Conv. proviennent de: Bounce, GA4 Leads and Conv. come from GA4, matched by page. GA4 Leads and Conv. follow the channel chosen above and attach each valuation request to the session's landing page (the entry page), not to the form page. “—” indicates insufficient traffic (< 100 landing sessions) or the home page “/”, shared by the parent site and the trade-in site and therefore not attributable.
Visiteurs de l'accueil menés jusqu'aux l: Home page visitors taken through to the valuation · {0}
leads GA ÷ sessions du site de reprise ·: valuations ÷ trade-in site sessions · exact days
leads GA ÷ visiteurs accueil · jours exa: valuations ÷ home page visitors · exact days
leads GA ÷ visiteurs accueil · période a: valuations ÷ home page visitors · approximate period (whole weeks/months)
Leads GA ÷ sessions du site de reprise,: GA leads ÷ trade-in site sessions, over the exact days of the period: the « classic » rate used by Looker and the presentations. It ignores how many steps were completed.
leads GA ÷ visiteurs de l'accueil (sessi: GA leads ÷ home-page visitors (trade-in site sessions unavailable for the period)
Part des VISITEURS (utilisateurs) de la: Share of home-page VISITORS (users) who reach the GA leads, step by step. It measures the journey and is useful to judge the funnel (V2, leaking steps). The overall rate next to it counts GA leads ÷ trade-in site sessions (same definition as Looker).
Pour chaque appareil ou canal d'acquisit: For each device or acquisition channel (Paid, Organic…): share of visitors (under each percentage: number of users who reached the step) who move from one step to the next (active users, months touched by the period). Green / red: at least 2 points above / below the site average on that step. « ≥ 100 % »: GA4 counts each step separately; some visitors reach a step without going through the previous one (skipped step, going back), so the share exceeds 100 %. Last column: end-to-end conversion; the « Site average » row is computed on total visitors, not as an average of percentages.
Sessions du site de reprise → In Journey: Trade-in site sessions → In Journey → GA leads. In Journey = sessions that reach the form or the confirmation page (host name = trade-in site and page category « form page » or « lead page »). GA leads = tradein_request events. Same definitions and same figures as the « Monthly Quick Look » Looker report (whole months: GA4 monthly totals). Change shown vs the comparison period.
Période en jours : somme des jours (jusq: Period in days: sum of the days (up to ~1 % more than Looker's monthly totals)
